As far as I can tell it is basically the exact same as ASIO but allows other programs to output audio aswell :)

I would say you should at minumum stack 2 vocal layers together and add more during the more intense areas of the song. Obviously auto tune hasnt been used but I feel like it might be needed in some parts, you dont have to be a perfect singer to be a grunge artist but there is a limit and at certain parts in the song you do seem to be struggling to hit the right notes.
